# [In preview] Public Preview: Ubuntu 26.04 support in AKS

## What Changed

Teams running Ubuntu node pools on AKS need to stay current with Ubuntu LTS releases, but each OS transition can introduce package footprint, security, and compatibility concerns. Ubuntu 26.04 support introduces the Ubuntu2604 OS SKU using Ubuntu Minimal

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This may change the workload security posture or required controls.

## Customer Impact

**High**. Lifecycle: `public-preview`. Change type: `security`.
